g.text: Deployment diagram - variant on a university GPU server (proposal, not deployed)
GPU server (Linux, NVIDIA GPU with 24 GB or more)
Same code and configuration keys as on the laptop: only LLM_BASE_URL,
LLM_MODEL and EMBEDDING_DEVICE change. No request leaves the university network.
Needed before real use and not in the prototype: an identity provider instead of
static API keys, backups of SQLite and Qdrant, more API workers, monitoring.
language, prompts, LLM providers, verifier, answer service
libraries and systems outside the repository
